services.name: become a licensed skydiver
services.desc: You can get your license to become a skydiver at Cloud Chasers! We have an AFF (Accelerated Freefall) program and instructor. We provide all the equipment you will need and expert guidance and instruction. At the same time, you will enjoy camaraderie with a large group of jumpers that already have their license

gap: Exact duration of each jump or training session not stated
blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives with an instructor or enroll in a student training program to become licensed skydivers. The training includes ground school, AFF jumps, coach jumps, and solo jumps. The facility also offers gear rental and video recording of jumps.
extraNote: $90 deposit required to assure specific tandem jump time, part of $225 total · Instructor can refuse service for safety concerns; full refund if refusal within weight limits and honest reporting · Failure to report accurate weight can cause delays or inability to jump; no refund for this · Appointment time is arrival time, not jump time; late arrival can cause schedule delays · At the airport hangar; additional directions needed once on airport · Year round
